angels-lifegain.wish: I want a lifegain deck with angels — white, maybe black too. Angels that gain me life and keep me alive.

vampires-lifegain.wish: I want a lifegain deck with vampires — black and white. Vampires that gain me life and drain the table.

brief.angle: a wide board of vampires that trigger lifegain and drain opponents on combat damage
brief.fantasy: a board full of vampires swinging in together, draining life from the whole table every combat

drain-incremental.wish: I want vampires that drain the table with lots of small life-loss triggers every turn, grinding opponents down over time and steadily — not a combo finish, not one big swing.

mechanics: steady attrition rather than combo finish
